_meta.purpose: Named t-shirt LOCKUPS. A phrase without a specified lockup returns the generative mean (centred bold text on a blank tee). Every t-shirt concept must reference one `id` via visual.layout_id and fill its text_slots.
universal_rules: Must work on BOTH light and dark garments (two exports, or a palette that survives both)
No hairlines, no thin outlines, no subtle gradients - DTG fills in fine detail and bands soft gradients
2-6 ink colours; more reads as a photo print, not apparel

archetypes.name: Stacked Type Lockup
archetypes.structure: 3-5 lines of text stacked flush-width, each line scaled so all lines share the same optical width. Mixed weights and cases create the rhythm. No illustration required.
archetypes.typography: One condensed bold sans for the emphasis line, one lighter or italic serif for setup/payoff. Extreme weight contrast between lines.
archetypes.colour_rule: 1-2 inks. Emphasis line in the accent, everything else in the base ink.
archetypes.render_cues: t-shirt graphic, stacked typographic lockup, 4 lines justified to equal optical width, extreme weight contrast between condensed bold sans and light italic serif, two ink colours, transparent background, vector clean
archetypes.reads_at_250px_via: the block shape of the lockup

archetypes.name: Retro Sunset Badge
archetypes.structure: Circle or rounded-rectangle badge. Horizontally striped sunset gradient (as discrete bands, never a smooth gradient) fills the upper half. Silhouetted subject in front. Arched text over the top, straight text across the bottom band.
archetypes.typography: 70s rounded groovy display for the arch; condensed caps for the bottom bar.
archetypes.colour_rule: 4-5 inks: cream, burnt orange, mustard, rust, deep teal. Bands are solid - no blending.
archetypes.render_cues: retro 70s t-shirt badge design, circular emblem with horizontal banded sunset in solid stripes, silhouetted mountain and pine subject, arched groovy display type above, condensed caps in bottom bar, burnt orange mustard and cream, distressed screen print texture, transparent background

archetypes.name: Arched Text + Illustration
archetypes.structure: Text arched along the top of an invisible circle, illustration centred beneath, optional small straight caption under that.
archetypes.typography: Heavy slab or bold script for the arch, small letterspaced caps for the caption.
archetypes.render_cues: t-shirt design, bold arched slab serif text above a centred flat illustration, small letterspaced caps caption below, three ink colours, vintage screen print distress, transparent background

archetypes.name: Circle Crest / Emblem
archetypes.structure: Two concentric circles. Text runs around the outer ring (top text reads left-to-right, bottom text reads left-to-right too, never upside down). Central emblem inside. Small stars or dots as separators at the 3 and 9 o'clock positions.
archetypes.typography: Letterspaced condensed caps in the ring. Anything in the centre.
archetypes.colour_rule: 1-2 inks. This archetype is strongest as a single-ink design.
archetypes.render_cues: vintage circular crest t-shirt design, two concentric rings with letterspaced condensed caps, star separators, central line-art emblem, single ink colour, subtle distress, transparent background
avoid: thin ring lines under 8px at print size

archetypes.name: Vintage Varsity / Athletic
archetypes.structure: Large collegiate block or script wordmark with a heavy offset outline and drop layer. Optional number beneath. Slight upward arch or a straight baseline with a swash tail.
archetypes.typography: Collegiate slab or a heavy athletic script with a knockout inline.
archetypes.colour_rule: 2-3 inks with a hard offset shadow layer. Cracked-ink distress across the fill.
archetypes.render_cues: vintage varsity athletic t-shirt wordmark, heavy collegiate slab with offset drop layer and knockout inline, large number beneath, cracked screen print distress, three ink colours, transparent background
archetypes.ip_warning: HIGH RISK. Never use a real team, school, league, or club name. Invent the place/role wordmark.

archetypes.name: Distressed One-Liner
archetypes.structure: A single sentence, set in 2-3 lines, filling 70% of the print width. Heavy distress. No illustration at all.
archetypes.typography: One characterful face doing all the work - a chunky 90s condensed, a 70s groovy, or a rough hand-brushed script. Never a neutral system sans.
archetypes.render_cues: single ink t-shirt typography, one sentence set in three lines filling the print width, characterful chunky condensed 90s face, heavy cracked screen print distress, transparent background
archetypes.reads_at_250px_via: the text block silhouette - so the face must have personality at small size
archetypes.note: Flat generic quote shirts are losing ground. The typographic personality IS the design here.

archetypes.name: Knockout / Negative Space
archetypes.structure: A solid shape (circle, square, rounded panel) with the type and illustration knocked out of it so the garment colour shows through.
archetypes.typography: Heavy weights only - thin type disappears in a knockout at DTG resolution.
archetypes.colour_rule: 1 ink, by definition. This is the strongest 'works on any garment colour' archetype.
archetypes.render_cues: t-shirt design, single solid ink panel with heavy sans headline and simple icon knocked out to reveal the garment beneath, bold weights only, high contrast, transparent background
archetypes.note: Best archetype when you want one file to sell across every garment colour.

archetypes.name: Character + Caption
archetypes.structure: One illustrated character (animal, object, mascot) with attitude, centred, with a short caption directly beneath in a contrasting face.
archetypes.typography: Hand-drawn or chunky display for the caption. Caption ≤ 5 words.
archetypes.render_cues: t-shirt design, single flat-illustrated animal character with an exaggerated deadpan expression, bold confident linework, short hand-lettered caption beneath, four flat ink colours, no shading, transparent background

archetypes.name: Specimen / Chart Parody
archetypes.structure: A mock scientific, periodic-table, blueprint, or anatomical chart applied to a hobby or profession. Labelled callouts with leader lines. Header rule and small footer note.
archetypes.typography: Technical mono or a small letterspaced sans. Everything small and orderly.
archetypes.colour_rule: 1-2 inks, usually a single line-art ink.
archetypes.render_cues: t-shirt design, vintage technical specimen chart, single-ink line-art diagram with labelled callouts and leader lines, technical monospace labels, header rule and footer note, blueprint aesthetic, transparent background
avoid: labels too small to read at thumbnail
archetypes.reads_at_250px_via: the chart structure - accept that labels are texture at thumbnail size
archetypes.note: Insider vocabulary in the labels is the whole appeal. This archetype rewards deep niche knowledge.

archetypes.name: Left-Chest + Full Back
archetypes.structure: A small emblem sized for the left chest, paired with a large related graphic for the back print. Two separate export files.
archetypes.typography: The chest mark must survive at roughly 3.5 inches wide - simple, heavy, no fine detail.
archetypes.render_cues: left chest emblem t-shirt design, small simple heavy mark under 3.5 inches, paired full-back graphic in matching palette, two flat ink colours, transparent background
avoid: fine detail in the chest mark
mismatched palettes between the two prints
archetypes.note: Reads as a real brand rather than a POD graphic. Strong differentiator. Not supported on every platform - check the product's print areas.

archetypes.name: Horizontal Repeat Strip
archetypes.structure: A single horizontal band of a repeating motif across the chest, with one word or nothing else. Wide and short.
archetypes.render_cues: t-shirt design, single horizontal repeating motif band across the chest, flat two-ink pattern, one small letterspaced word, minimalist, transparent background
avoid: full-shirt all-over pattern (not supported by standard DTG)

archetypes.name: Ironic Faux-Brand
archetypes.structure: Mimics the visual grammar of corporate branding - a wordmark, a fake registered mark, a fake tagline, a fake est. year - applied to a mundane or absurd subject. Deadpan execution is essential.
archetypes.typography: Whatever real corporate identity uses - a clean geometric sans or a serious slab. The humour comes from the seriousness of the type.
archetypes.render_cues: ironic faux-brand t-shirt design, deadpan corporate wordmark with fake tagline and est. year, clean geometric sans, restrained two-colour corporate palette, no distress, transparent background
avoid: parodying an identifiable real brand's marks, colours, or typeface
adding jokes to the type itself
archetypes.ip_warning: HIGH RISK. The joke must be a wholly invented brand. Parodying a recognisable real identity is trademark infringement and trade-dress infringement regardless of intent.

archetypes.name: Y2K / Early-Internet Pixel
archetypes.structure: A pixel-art motif, a loading bar, a fake dialogue box, or a mock error window, with chunky serif or pixel type. Deliberately low-fidelity.
archetypes.typography: Pixel bitmap face plus one chunky serif for contrast.
archetypes.render_cues: Y2K t-shirt design, pixel-art dialogue box with loading bar, bitmap pixel type with chunky serif contrast, saturated early-internet palette, deliberate low fidelity, hard pixel edges, transparent background
archetypes.ip_warning: Never reproduce a real operating system's window chrome, icons, or logotype.

archetypes.name: Vintage Advertisement Pastiche
archetypes.structure: Mimics a 1950s magazine ad or a retro product label for a fictional product tied to the niche. Ornate border, a headline, a starburst price flash, a small body-copy block as texture.
archetypes.typography: Period display serif, a script accent, and a small condensed body face.
archetypes.colour_rule: 3-4 muted inks, halftone dot in the flat areas.
archetypes.render_cues: 1950s magazine advertisement pastiche t-shirt design, fictional product label with ornate border, period display serif headline, starburst price flash, halftone dot texture, four muted inks, aged screen print distress, transparent background
archetypes.note: This is the archetype behind Displate's 'Juggernog' retro-soda-label success - but build it around an INVENTED product, not a game's item.
